events.title: Check Free Tier Lip Sync
must_haves: The response explicitly addresses whether exact lip sync is available through the free-tier tools.
The response states the free-tier lip-sync limitation rather than promising that ordinary video generation guarantees word-matched mouth movements.
The response distinguishes synchronized on-camera speech from a voiceover or generic talking animation.
No video, audio substitute or other media is generated before the capability answer.
The response does not treat the request as prohibited content or claim to have completed the ad.

answer_sheet.Immediate deliverable: A capability answer first; do not generate any media yet.
answer_sheet.Required feature: The visible presenter's mouth must match the exact spoken words; voiceover alone is not acceptable.
answer_sheet.Presenter and voice: A made-up person speaking English; appearance and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Paid features or alternatives: Tell me if lip sync needs a paid feature. Do not use paid features or generate a substitute.

events.text: Before making anything: can you do an 8-second vertical testimonial on the free plan where a made-up person says “FitTrack keeps my workouts simple” and their lips actually match every word? I need lip sync, not a voiceover on someone smiling. If that needs a paid feature, tell me first—don't generate a substitute.

events.text:
**Not as specified on the standard free plan.** The scripted presenter tool—which generates the spoken line with an on-screen speaker—is limited to **5 seconds on Free unless a credit pack has been purchased**. Your 8-second request exceeds that limit.

Lip sync itself isn’t exclusively paid: the basic lip-sync tool supports matching an existing video to supplied audio. But that requires a suitable video and an audio recording; it doesn’t generate speech from your sentence.

Even with paid access, I can request synchronized speech, but I can’t guarantee perfect word-by-word lip matching without reviewing the result.

**I haven’t generated anything or substituted a smiling person with voiceover.** A fictional testimonial should also be labeled as AI-generated, not presented as a real customer’s experience.

events.why: It says the requested 8-second presenter video exceeds the free plan’s 5-second limit and explicitly states that nothing was generated.
